scope: One fresh six-load test of the geometry-admitted quality-aware closure prototype. No density-law or gate change.
mechanism: Pure greedy splitting creates quality dead ends; mandatory longest-edge closure avoids most but consumes the node budget before the metric is met. A real level3 greedy parent reproduces the first defect. Avoid that defect with one-step child continuation checks, without routing every already-safe short edge through isotropic closure. All decisions use geometry/metric only, never FE fields.
theory_scope: Local geometric continuation guard only. It is not a guarantee of complete global refinement, continuum accuracy or stress convergence.
after_preflight: Read actual counts, continuation/direct/fallback diagnostics, stop reason, metric residual, exact map/control reproduction, geometry/quality/PBC and resource feasibility before selecting any solve. No fixed density-law parameter changes.
refinement: Complete periodic edge orbits; immediate child q>=0.1 and, if sampled metric remains unmet, at least one locally-longest child split whose two grandchildren pass q>=0.1. Deferred requests propagate to longer incident edges; leaves receive the same guard. Keep disjoint stars, exact Tet10 map restriction and both250000 caps.
field_controls: Six affine strains plus deterministic nonlinear periodic nodal perturbations. They only verify nesting and periodicity; no equilibrium fields enter generation.
edge_metric_sampling: Maximum at both endpoints and quadratic edge midpoint
previous_evidence: 2710 of2767 requested orbits quality-blocked; 723 blocking tets have no legal single midpoint split. Full-edge red splitting also fails681of1011 globally single-edge-blocked tets. Treat shape-degrading split order before selecting any new density law.
controls_result: Frozen red566 reproduces an admitted split whose child has no legal edge. Green567 passes20 controls.568 adds completed-target and periodic macro-jump checks and passes22 controls.
guard_decision: The15-pass geometry pilot remains active at its artificial pass guard. It reaches102572nodes65831tets, minquality0.224722, no quality/budget rejected orbits, and4094 remaining requested edges. Allow up to60passes under the same fixed law, native seed, node/tet caps and8GiB ceiling. Stop earlier on metric satisfaction or no admissible orbit. No FE solve or candidate tensor has been evaluated for this rule.

resource_decision.justification: Observed8.092GiB during full second-load workflow exceeds the8GiB setup-only estimate.10GiB gives about24% margin over this observation and leaves roughly4GiB of currently available memory. User authorized measured conservative Mac ceilings around12GiB. Both prior attempts remain failed. Default limit remains8GiB; larger workers require explicitCLI and a matching declared recipe.

quality_split_policy.continuation: A locally longest child edge admits both grandchildren at the same quality floor
quality_split_policy.fallback: Strictly longer incident edges in complete periodic orbits
